name: Commercial Construction
summary: Commercial tenant improvements, interior build-outs, renovations and coordinated construction for offices, retail, restaurants, medical spaces and managed properties across the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
features: Repairs for occupied and managed properties

faqs.question: What types of commercial properties do you work on?
faqs.answer: We work on offices, retail spaces, restaurants, medical and professional suites, managed properties and other small to mid-size commercial facilities.

faqs.question: Can you coordinate multiple trades for a commercial build-out?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can coordinate framing, drywall, acoustical ceilings, painting, flooring, carpentry and approved plumbing, electrical and HVAC work under one project schedule.

faqs.question: Do you handle tenant improvements in occupied buildings?
faqs.answer: Yes. The work can be phased around business operations when practical, with attention to access, dust control, daily cleanup and communication with property management.

faqs.question: Can you build or remodel an ADA restroom?
faqs.answer: Yes. Commercial restroom work can include layout changes, framing, drywall, tile, fixtures, grab bars, clearances and coordination with applicable permit and inspection requirements.

faqs.question: Do commercial projects require permits?
faqs.answer: Many tenant improvements and build-outs require permits and inspections depending on the city and scope. Permit needs should be confirmed before construction begins.
